applicability: Application-owned business feature in the Examples template
limitations: One currency, positive integer quantities, at most 50 lines and one designated non-self reviewer
No multi-level approvals, tax, stock reservation or workflow editor
Reference searches return at most 100 matches; reviewer membership is checked before the transaction
Default integration requires explicit runtime/store and UI registration; see docs/procurement.md
Example verification and independent agent adaptation outcomes are separate records
